input_requirement: The system shall process 95 percent of all queries within 1.5 seconds and must not take longer than 4 seconds to process queries at any given time.

ambiguities.fragment: 95 percent of all queries within 1.5 seconds and must not take longer than 4 seconds to process queries at any given time.
ambiguities.explanation: The logical connectives 'and' and 'must not' lack defined operator precedence, yielding two mutually exclusive conditions for query processing: (1) the system must process 95 percent of all queries within 1.5 seconds, and it is allowed to take longer than 4 seconds on some queries; or (2) the system must process all queries within 1.5 seconds, and it is not allowed to take longer than 4 seconds on any query.
possible_interpretations: The system must process at least 95 percent of all queries within 1.5 seconds, but there is no guarantee that every query will be processed within this time frame; the remaining queries may take longer than 4 seconds to process.
The system must process all queries within 1.5 seconds, and it is not allowed to take longer than 4 seconds on any given query.
